last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 9
last_episode_to_air.overview: Ece's near-death experience in the cold storage brings Onur and Ece closer again. Ece wants to find Hazar at all costs and make up for her mistake. Ece puts herself in danger again.  Ece being taken hostage by Hazar becomes a moment of enlightenment for Onur. He loves Ece more than anyone and anything in his life. He is now ready to overcome all obstacles to claim his love.

name: Love Undercover
overview: Onur Karasu is a successful intelligence agent who was promoted to head of the department at a young age and has been after Civan Koral, the owner of Turkey's largest jewelry company. Onur, who thinks that Civan keeps the documents related to his illegal business in the safe in his house, becomes lovers with Civan's sister Hilal  in order to get in and out of the house. When he learns that Civan will move abroad, Onur makes a sudden decision to propose to Hilal in order to get the documents without letting her get away. He plans to open the safe on their engagement day and arrest Civan, who is there for his sister's engagement. What he doesn't take into account is Hilal's close friend Ece. While Ece is trying to figure out what Onur is up to, her plans are upset when Onur catches her. Onur and Ece, two poles as opposite as day and night, will have to work together in a way they never wanted to.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An agent who sees nothing but his job with the eyes of honor; Ece, on the other hand, is a dazzling professional thief with a thousand and one skills. Onur and Ece; day and night…
